scope: Operator inspection and explicit abandonment of unpublished pending corrections, preserving branches, saved results and billing events.

publication.scope: Frozen repository snapshots, correction reconciliation module, operator CLI/runbook, focused tests and this validation evidence.

operator_contract.credentials: Uses only the payer's stored user GitHub connection; no token arguments or saved preview content are printed.
operator_contract.frozen_repository: Owner, repository, base branch and starting commit are saved before creating the unique operation branch in all four PR correction routes.
operator_contract.concurrency: Inspection and abandonment acquire the same payer lock as application workers and re-read the receipt under that lock. Lost PostgreSQL leases prevent release.
operator_contract.github_reads: Verify repository identity, search all PR states for the exact head without a base filter, read the frozen starting commit to verify code access, then inspect the correction ref.
operator_contract.abandonment: Requires an operator and reason. Unpaid work with no saved preview/PR may be released if no write was intended, the branch is confirmed absent, or it still points at the starting commit.
operator_contract.partial_commits: Changed unpublished branches require an explicit --retain-branch action after operator review. The remote branch and all commits remain untouched.
operator_contract.audit: Record timestamp, operator, reason and observed evidence/SHA in the same transaction that marks the receipt abandoned and clears its request key.
operator_contract.billing: No usage-event changes, refunds or charges. Previously paid previews remain available for confirmation without another provider call or debit.
operator_contract.refusals: Any PR, charged work, saved preview/PR, missing legacy snapshot, inconsistent repository, unknown GitHub result, code-access denial, active worker or lost lease prevents abandonment.
operator_contract.non_destructive: No GitHub write, branch deletion, merge, model call, worker startup, migration or automatic batch cleanup. Other pending operations continue to block their payer.
operator_contract.external_actor_limit: Application locks cannot exclude manual GitHub changes; the runbook requires operators to avoid concurrent manual branch/PR operations.

verified_scenarios: Absent and unchanged branches: read-only inspection followed by explicit audited release
Changed partial branch refuses ordinary release; explicit retention preserves its SHA
Open, closed, merged, multiple and malformed nonempty PR results all refuse abandonment
Missing snapshots, invalid branch identity, malformed refs and inconsistent repositories refuse release
Missing contents permissions cannot be inferred as an absent branch from repository visibility
Authentication failures, rate limits, server errors and redirects fail closed
Provider crash before any external write can be abandoned without a GitHub call
Saved preview/PR and charged results are protected; usage-event totals stay unchanged
A payer's active worker prevents operator action on SQLite and PostgreSQL
Real PostgreSQL lease termination after GitHub reads prevents request-key release
A PR appearing after an earlier inspection is checked again and prevents abandonment
Releasing one operation does not release another pending operation
CLI list, inspect and abandon run in child processes against isolated SQLite and PostgreSQL databases
Real authenticated API: ambiguous confirmation write, blocked replay, operator reconciliation, fresh branch and one PR; one model call and one debit overall

verification.github_and_provider: Injected responses; no real GitHub transport fault or Claude call in this phase.

full_local_suite.skip_note: Nine PostgreSQL guard cases, two PostgreSQL API cases, thirty PostgreSQL reconciliation cases and one SQLite-inapplicable lease-termination case. PostgreSQL cases pass in the separate run.

targeted_real_postgres_run.skip_note: Only the SQLite instance of the PostgreSQL lease-termination test is inapplicable.
